Keep every major room object, source camera, window mullion, lake/town/hills, desk/chair/bookcase, porcelain lamp/round side table, window bench/cushions/throw, floor/rug and foreground perspective at Image 1's original positions/sizes. No zoom, crop, mirror, new furniture, montage, UI rectangle, gray/white panel, text, labels, watermark, arrows, halo, speech balloon, readable fake business document or completion badge. Keep complete top hair, both hands and fingers, full clothes/hem, knees/ankles and both entire shoes in frame, with source support material and believable occlusion/weight. Do not shrink her into a distant doll or enlarge her toward the lens. TARGET MIST / overcast-day: Image1 has soft bright blue-white cloudy daylight and a readable lake/mountain distance; retain the real low practical lamp glow. Replace hard sunny stripes with this diffuse light across room, cushion AND person. Keep healthy skin and original clothing/hair pigments; her attention stays lively rather than washed-out blue. No new rainfall or dawn sun invented.

CHARACTER / complete daily wardrobe: Yuutenji Nyamu (祐天寺若麦 / にゃむ), short lavender-purple bob ending at jaw/nape, uneven light fringe with longer fine cheek strands, clear rose/red-purple irises, fresh youthful face, expressive but not mature makeup or baby proportions. Grey ruffled short-sleeve off-shoulder blouse with thin black shoulder straps and real front buttons, fine black neck choker, black high-waisted belted short skirt, BARE natural legs, TWO complete black low-stable block-heel ankle-strap shoes. Do not add calf socks/stockings, brown loafers, stage garters or a school uniform. This complete daily outfit follows her dossier, not a random mixed costume. Keep grey fabric and skin distinct, black skirt folds and ankle straps readable. She wants her effort to be seen and has wit and initiative, but need not perform for a camera. No camera/phone/livestream UI, permanent wink, cat-mouth or identical sales smile.

THIS INSTANT — RESUME / FAMILIAR RECOGNITION: her own not-quite-finished small paper bird is still between her fingers, a few earlier paper folds lie honestly on the same bench. On hearing the familiar returning person she turns attention first, with bright recognition in rose-purple eyes and an unguarded small asymmetric smile; one palm still rests on actual cushion and the raised hand still truly holds the little bird. Preserve this healthy source action, not a new waving welcome gesture, fake memory card or 'already done for you' stamp. Her desire to show the next rough attempt is readable, while the returning person can just sit. Let shoulders release half a beat after the eyes, distinct from the intense listening face and from the laugh at a crooked fold.

EXACT CELL'S CREATIVE BRIEF (historical planning hold has now been explicitly released by root for this exact missing cell; creative intent retained, current complete dossier has priority):
她把未完成的那一遍留在手边，见你回来，先给了一个很熟悉的眼神。没有把中断装成盛大的重逢，也没急着证明自己一直在替你忙。那一版可以接着改，她也愿意先听听，你回来时带着什么新的念头。

新一页的清晨不抹掉旧的一版，也允许今天想法不同。

晨雾蓝：通透蓝白的早光让纸、书架和面孔一起变清楚，灰上衣不是一片冰蓝。她可以带着还没排练完的神气醒来，也能很快认真；不用晨光把她变成另一个乖巧人偶。

祐天寺若麦的原作青春二次元辨识：短至下颌与颈侧的薰衣草紫 bob，柔软不齐刘海与侧边发丝，红紫眼；细致而鲜活的年轻脸。维持已核身份文字中的灰色荷叶边短袖上衣与细肩带、黑色细颈圈、黑短裙及低稳跟踝带鞋，衣着自然完整。不是成熟写实时装照，不用过重妆容或魅惑摆拍代替性格；不自动塞入正在拍摄的手机或相机。

从原有书页或轻纸作品旁自然抬头，身体微转向对方，一只手仍保留真实物件的位置；不重复闲聊的大开场手势。

只给出基本姿势：让髋与真实座垫、手与书页或支撑面确实接触，膝踝关系自然，鞋与地面或自然悬垂随具体姿势成立；不以脚数或固定腿长比例判断。脸、视线、刘海和手部要清楚，衣着完整，关键肢体不靠裁切掩盖。

承接用户选定的新文学居室，而非旧 room4：近而不压迫的相机、分格木窗与湖山远景，左后方真正有人使用的书桌和木椅，书架、纸张与小物的生活层次；窗边长软榻、邻近的小边桌、陶瓷灯、书与杯，织物的触感和有限的前景景深。最终相机、家具、留白与人物尺度以 root 新空房 plate 和已通过的单祥子跨情境打样为准，不自行锁像素坐标，不把本参考中的祥子身体或旧房间带入。画面是一整个自然房间，不画 UI、文字标签、箭头、轨迹、拼贴分界或水印。

Final invariant: one whole room and one nyamu only, full1536x1024 opaque RGB. The theme changes light, not identity, age, complete wardrobe or action's meaning. Preserve actual source support and full contour. This is a mother candidate; not a cutout, layer mask, runtime screenshot or claim of independently moving pose.
